biography: Born in Montevideo, Uruguay, Liam Robinson's racing journey began with a battered go-kart gifted by his grandfather, a former amateur rally driver. Liam spent his childhood tearing around dusty tracks on his family's farm, honing his skills through sheer grit and determination. His raw talent was undeniable, catching the eye of a local racing team during a regional karting championship where he finished second despite mechanical issues in the final race. Liam made the bold decision to pursue racing independently, relying on sponsorship and family support. He currently competes in Formula 4, making a name for himself with daring overtakes and aggressive defensive maneuvers, although consistency remains a challenge.
drivingStyle: Robinson's driving style is characterized by fearless aggression and a never-say-die attitude. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and squeezing opponents at every opportunity. While this approach often yields spectacular results, it also leads to occasional misjudgments and collisions. He's still learning to balance his natural aggression with strategic tire management and racecraft, but his raw speed is undeniable.

careerHighlight: Winning the Uruguayan National Karting Championship in 2020, his first major victory and a testament to his dedication after years of self-funded racing.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Formula 4 race at Interlagos in 2023, costing him a potential podium finish and crucial championship points.
